transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Maya, curator for the festival exhibition. As we get started, I want to flag that I still have final authority to approve the public opening plan for "Tidal Memory" in Gallery 4. The current draft has online-connected playback, eight visitor stations, 15-minute sessions, and a 5:00 PM public opening on October 12 — but before I sign off, I need to hear from each of you. Rights, technical, accessibility, artist reps — please state any conditions that must be added to this plan before I can approve it.
